integrity.logical_evidence: direct gap-count identity; invertible tail counts; two-way packing construction; 3-PARTITION reduction

limitations: The exact theorem concerns finite cyclic one-dimensional binary occupancy, complete uniformly translated contiguous-window means, and every species present at least once; no generalization to arbitrary planar sampling geometries is claimed.
Recovery is of the pooled absence-gap length multiset, not of species assignment or location. The NP-completeness statement concerns exact feasibility with dimensions in unary, not noisy estimation.
Finite checker outputs corroborate small instances but are not an infinite proof; an unrestricted mathematical proof and a direct reduction from 3-PARTITION are supplied.
Possible prior results outside the inspected material and inaccessible older documents cannot be ruled out; independent audit is not performed.
title: Exact realizability and strong NP-completeness of cyclic-transect richness curves
